page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration provides 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, paired with 64.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile characterized by moderate multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance falls into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression register in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by the stress-ng multi-core and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression benchmarks. Memory bandwidth remains consistently in the average tier, with read-only large block transfers reaching 77.7 GB/sec and write operations at 59.92 GB/sec.

The instance is suited for workloads that benefit from parallel execution rather than high single-threaded clock speeds. Database operations, static web serving, and Redis SET operations all perform within the average tier, processing 11.29 million operations per second in Redis tests. For machine learning, the instance handles small-scale LLM inference with a 135M model at average speeds but drops to weak performance tiers when processing larger 7B models. This makes the instance appropriate for general-purpose application hosting, multi-threaded utility processing, and moderate database workloads where single-core latency is not a critical constraint.
